operations.name: glm

params.name: family
params.description: GLM response variable, row-major: one inner array per observation. Required on some paths of this model; see durable-memory/json-api.md.

params.name: link
params.description: GLM link; default is the family's canonical link.

params.name: link_power
params.description: Required when link="power": the power exponent for the generic power-transform link (g(mu) = mu^power, links.py::Power).

params.description: Negative-Binomial dispersion parameter, FIXED (not estimated), default 1.0.

params.name: var_power
params.description: Tweedie power-variance-function parameter (V(mu) = mu^var_power), default 1.5 (the common insurance-claims/compound-Poisson-Gamma value).

params.description: Tweedie only: if true, use statsmodels' Extended Quasi-Likelihood approximation for loglike/AIC/BIC.

params.name: exposure

params.name: var_weights

params.name: freq_weights

params.name: elastic_net_l1_wt

params.name: elastic_net_maxiter
